prompt: The loop skips some elements. Why?
choices: get() and remove() cannot be used in the same loop
After removing at index i, the element that was at i+1 shifts to i and is never checked
list.size() must be stored before the loop
Integers cannot be removed by index from ArrayList
explanation: When list.remove(1) removes the element at index 1 (value 2), value 3 shifts from index 2 to index 1. i increments to 2 — skipping 3. Fix: use removeIf(n -> n % 2 == 0) or decrement i after each removal.
